_comment: STR-03 retrieval corpus. Frozen before tuning: each split carries the SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(cases); test/retrievalEval.test.js verifies it. Splits are disjoint by family (negatives aside). expect = acceptable files at pinnedCommit; [] = nothing should be returned. Run: node scripts/eval/run-retrieval.js
